title: MLX_OMARCHY_FUSED_CHAIN paired full-ID identity + performance gate, candidate 2f54fcb, native M1 (Linux aarch64, Vulkan)

decision.rationale: Fusion is identity-safe here (15/15 pairs full-ID elementwise equal) but the paired-median decode gain is roughly 1.0-1.5%: long +0.974%, ctx1024 +1.032%, short +1.526%, on one pinned 4-bit 0.5B model, with one regressing pair on long128. The paired median ratio is the median of the 5 per-pair ON/OFF ratios; the ratio of the separate run medians is a different quantity and is NOT the paired median (short 31.9638/31.4143 = 1.01749 is NOT the paired median; the paired median is 1.0152627). A modest ~1% gain on a single pinned model is not broad-model rollout qualification; the flag stays opt-in.

provenance.source_note: RoPE bf16 wrapped-path fix + reviewed fusion

normal.test_binaries_note: compiled-tape and fused-chain test binaries were built separately from the same source commit 2f54fcb0738bc23e6b5987bcc6b341825759d3c4 (not from the normal wheel)

diag.used_for: GPU profiler-instrumented profile_generate + chain_census runs only

build.cpu_backend_note: MLX_BUILD_CPU=ON is ACTUAL release-equivalent packaging per scripts/build-wheel.sh:98 (hardcoded, intentional; README documents CPU stream support); parent-confirmed appropriate, not a deviation
build.metal_note: MLX_BUILD_METAL=OFF: Vulkan/omarchy backend on Linux. No native-Metal performance parity is claimed or implied by this receipt.

flags_effective.uniformity: exactly 2 flag combinations across all 30 legs (verified); MLX_OMARCHY_DENSE_GEMV=0, MLX_OMARCHY_ROPE_BF16_DIRECT=0, MLX_OMARCHY_SDPA_BF16_FAST=0 on both sides; only MLX_OMARCHY_FUSED_CHAIN toggles 0->1

commands.pair_order: 5 pairs x {short,long,ctx1024} x {off,on}; pair order counterbalanced per plan.json

profile_exact_sanitized.compiled_tape_default: env -u MLX_DISABLE_COMPILE -u MLX_OMARCHY_FUSED_CHAIN -u MLX_OMARCHY_DENSE_GEMV -u MLX_OMARCHY_ROPE_BF16_DIRECT -u MLX_OMARCHY_SDPA_BF16_FAST -u MLX_OMARCHY_QMM_TILE -u MLX_OMARCHY_PER_NODE_SUBMIT <tests binary> (see ~/benchq/logs/combined-gate-2f54fcb0/provenance.txt)
profile_exact_sanitized.profile_off: env -u MLX_DISABLE_COMPILE -u MLX_OMARCHY_PER_NODE_SUBMIT -u MLX_OMARCHY_QMM_TILE -u MLX_OMARCHY_DENSE_GEMV -u MLX_OMARCHY_ROPE_BF16_DIRECT -u MLX_OMARCHY_SDPA_BF16_FAST MLX_OMARCHY_FUSED_CHAIN=0 MLX_OMARCHY_ALLOW_NON_APPLE=1 MLX_OMARCHY_GPU_PROFILE=~/benchq/logs/combined-gate-2f54fcb0/prof-off.jsonl <venv-diag python> .../profile_generate.py --model <pinned snapshot> --max-tokens 128 --prompt <manifest-long> --markers markers-off.jsonl

identity.method: capture-full-ids wrapper retained FULL integer ID arrays for every leg (no digest-only limitation this time)
identity.pair_equality: 15/15 pairs: ON full ID array elementwise equal to OFF full ID array
identity.digest_recompute: all 30 legs: sha256(','.join(ids))[:16] recomputed from the arrays in results.json == reported ids_sha256_16
identity.off_digest_canonical_check: every OFF leg digest equals the expected canonical digest for its workload

command_sanitized: You are reviewing a measurement protocol for a small language-model benchmark. The benchmark runs the same workload matrix on two operating systems and compares prefill and decode throughput. Each leg loads one pinned model snapshot, applies the model chat template to the prompt, runs greedy decoding with a fixed random seed, and records the prompt phase, the per-token phase, the generated token count, a hash of the generated token ids, and peak memory. A leg is valid only when the model snapshot revision matches the manifest pin, the power state is recorded, and no other model-serving process is holding the accelerator. The runner never downloads models on an offline host; a missing snapshot is reported as skipped, never as a pass. Provenance for each run captures the chip, core count, memory, operating system version and build, Python version, MLX and mlx-lm versions, the GPU driver identity where available, the exact source commit, and whether the source tree was dirty. Hostnames, user names, and serial numbers are deliberately excluded from the recorded output. Timing on a machine that is also serving other model processes is labeled contended and is not compared against clean numbers.

A leg is valid only when the model snapshot revision matches the manifest pin, the power state is recorded, and no other model-serving process is holding the accelerator. The runner never downloads models on an offline host; a missing snapshot is reported as skipped, never as a pass. Provenance for each run captures the chip, core count, memory, operating system version and build, Python version, MLX and mlx-lm versions, the GPU driver identity where available, the exact source commit, and whether the source tree was dirty. Hostnames, user names, and serial numbers are deliberately excluded from the recorded output. Timing on a machine that is also serving other model processes is labeled contended and is not compared against clean numbers.
